editorial_policy: Transcribed only printed numeric labels from original PDF pages. Not interpolated from pixels. Modelled power is NOT metered grid use; data center facility count is NOT MW. Global/country series are NOT Indonesia-specific. Three further figure-level label sets read directly from original printed Stanford PDF pages 30 and 39; no pixel interpolation. Modelled comparisons must not imply direct facility or Indonesian measurements.

figures.source_chart_basis: Printed data labels for total modelled power capacity in Figure 1.2.4; quarterly 2022Q1–2025Q4. Does not estimate actual electricity consumption.
figures.caution_id: Estimasi daya terpasang berbasis model chip AI, bukan penggunaan listrik yang terukur. Tidak merepresentasikan Indonesia.
figures.caution_en: Modelled AI power capacity, not measured electricity use or Indonesia data.

figures.title_en: Cumulative notable AI models by accelerator
figures.source_credit: Epoch AI, 2026, as reproduced in Stanford HAI AI Index 2026
figures.source_chart_basis: 2025 terminal labels of eight accelerator series in Figure 1.2.2. Endpoint counts only, not complete 2017–2025 time series. Categories may overlap for models using multiple hardware types.
figures.caution_id: Angka kumulatif model hingga 2025, bukan jumlah model baru pada 2025. Grafik asli memuat tren yang belum didigitalisasi; kategori akselerator tidak dijumlahkan.
figures.caution_en: Cumulative model count through 2025, NOT newly trained models in 2025. Only printed terminal values transcribed; accelerator categories must not be added together.

figures.title_en: Estimated AI query energy versus everyday activities
figures.source_credit: AI Index, 2025, as reproduced in Stanford HAI AI Index 2026
figures.source_chart_basis: All seven explicitly labelled bars in Figure 1.4.7, original PDF page 39. GPT-4o query estimates as of March 2025; comparisons not independently measured by SLI.
figures.caution_id: Estimasi energi per interaksi/sesi GPT-4o Maret 2025, bukan konsumsi listrik nasional atau pengukuran pusat data Indonesia. Angka sumber berbeda menurut panjang kueri.
figures.caution_en: Model-based GPT-4o interaction/session energy estimates for March 2025, not observed Indonesian electricity consumption or energy efficiency of newer models.

figures.title_id: Perbandingan estimasi konsumsi air tahunan AI
figures.title_en: Estimated annual AI inference water consumption comparisons
figures.geography: Published global AI inference comparison and baseline equivalents
figures.source_credit: AI Index, 2025, as reproduced in Stanford HAI AI Index 2026
figures.source_chart_basis: Six labelled bars Figure 1.4.8, original PDF page 39. 1,334,991 and 1,579,680 kL refer to GPT-4o inference range, not current measured national water withdrawal.
figures.caution_id: Perbandingan skenario tahunan dengan satuan kiloliter. Dua batang GPT-4o adalah estimasi minimum–maksimum, bukan dua konsumsi yang boleh dijumlah. Tidak merepresentasikan air yang dipakai Indonesia.
figures.caution_en: Published annual kL comparison; GPT-4o min/max are alternative estimate bounds, not additive or metered Indonesian freshwater withdrawals.
